name: RefPtrVector::EmplaceReallocate (std::vector<counted pointer> reallocating insert over operator new)
notes: Lane AJ. Hooked (not yet run in-game). Same algorithm as ServiceRefVector::InsertGrown (0x1d57e0) over operator new; the capacity limit throws bad_alloc where the allocator-service version clamps. Blocks of 4096 bytes and more are 32-byte aligned with the real pointer before them. Differential test, 12,000 seeds: inserts at the end, in the middle, empty vectors, null elements, blocks around the 4096-byte boundary (old and new), AddRef that throws (new block freed, vector unchanged), faked huge or negative capacities (bad_alloc; the allocation stub fails above 1 GB). Operator new/delete of the image and of our build are redirected to logging stubs, so allocation sizes, frees and leaks are compared event by event with the AddRef/Release events. Tracked blocks come from a private arena (not the process heap), so the heap-counting tests that run later are not disturbed. Mutants killed (11): growth factor, minimum size, big-block threshold, alignment mask, old-element release, old-block free, new-element release on error, new-block free on error, held range, stored capacity, old block size; inner copy cleanup killed. Equivalent (survived): removing the early capacity check, the later maximum check throws the same bad_alloc.
